# ⚡ Chapter 6: Leverage and Derivatives

::: info 🎯 In this chapter
MTF, futures, options and why most traders lose.
:::

## Units in this chapter

1. [Leverage and Margin](/leverage-derivatives/6.1-leverage-and-margin) - Understand how leverage magnifies gains and losses, what a margin call is, and how auto square-off works.
2. [MTF (Margin Trading Facility)](/leverage-derivatives/6.2-mtf-margin-trading-facility) - Understand how Margin Trading Facility works, its interest cost, pledging shares, and worked gain and loss examples.
3. [Futures](/leverage-derivatives/6.3-futures) - Understand futures contracts, lot size, expiry, mark-to-market settlement, and hedging vs speculation.
4. [Options](/leverage-derivatives/6.4-options) - Understand call and put options, premium, strike price, time value, and the asymmetric risk between buyers and sellers.
5. [Why Most Retail Traders Lose](/leverage-derivatives/6.5-why-most-retail-traders-lose) - What SEBI studies show about retail derivative trader losses, the role of costs and psychology, recent rule changes, and safer alternatives.
